At most four fresh20 attempts share1200requests/6M provider tokens; failed attempts remain immutable with complete recursive prior ledger. pairedComparison.methodology: Same frozen questions. Current and baseline final answers are graded anonymously in the same isolated answer-judge call when pairedGrade is true. Legacy grades remain visible for scoring-drift audit. All answerable questions remain in denominators, errors and missing judgments never count as correct. Memory retention judge does not see retrieval or answers and sees only formal content, never provenance quotes. Automatic same-model estimates; no independent human review. Prior 80 held-out questions are now fixed regression cases, not unseen blind evaluation.

historicalBaselineMatched.methodology: Mutually exclusive observed loss, not causal proof. All answerable cases stay in accuracy denominators; missing/uncertain judges never count as correct. Answer correctness is same-model post-hoc judgment, not independently validated. Joint judge memory/retrieval labels were found confounded and excluded from stage attribution. Paragraph control attribution uses actual gold paragraph links/full text. Missing one gold set does not prove no equivalent evidence existed, and whole paragraph visibility does not prove sufficient reading. Organization errors are not separately blamed without evidence from facet ablation.
